stage: Research P0-P4 with conditional single-factor P3
calibration: actor-only GT replay, one per nonempty scene/seed; not a controller comparison
native_noise_seed: explicit xtensor shared RNG seed before configure; regenerate_noises=false
gazebo_seed: Fortress CLI unavailable; actual actor/robot initial positions and matched motion are audited
stvl: real 2.3.4 voxel marking/clearing/decay=.5s plus real InflationLayer; no future union
footprint: original .32/.27 rectangle + .02 padding; mechanical oracle .325/.300 full wheel envelope is separately evaluated
perception: existing frozen canonical LaserScan tracker, source-time TF, public v2; CV uses its estimated velocity; no new tracking
E: not separate: frozen KF already estimates the velocity used by C; duplicating identical C is not a meaningful group
execution: original Gazebo four-omni physics, 1ms integration and real smoother20Hz; no artificial B/C/D-only self truth or ideal actuation
observation_delay: actual source/processing/publish/receipt/consume times measured; same sensor15Hz/geometry and configuration
output_delay: actual controller/smoother/stub/bridge/feedback clocks observed; not asserted hardware apply ACK
fault: stale scenario follows wait-release motion; adapter suppresses predictions during goal+4..5.2s for B/C/D; STVL scans continue
invalid_input_policy: set native fail_flag; original MPPI retry, Nav2 failure_tolerance/recovery and smoother/stub timeout remain; no second cmd publisher
safety_gate: real actor contact zero, sampled full mechanical body clearance>=.05m with .003m numerical tolerance; no sampled wall overlap; full goal success required
worthwhile: C vs A must improve safe task completion in >=2 scenes with both seeds agreeing, or paired time>=10% improvement in >=2 scenes with no new safety or task regression; exploratory n2, no significance claim
p3_entry: only a repeatable P2 bottleneck and diagnostic evidence; max one main factor, no new optimizer/controller; reproduce original scenarios and untouched seed47
p3_possible_factor: only if demonstrated far-risk/combined-cost bottleneck: full horizon temporal time weighting with first1s unchanged; no removal of current STVL constraint
oracle_grade: replay actual actor GT from separate identical fixture; post-run actual motion alignment/error must be audited. If oracle mismatch exceeds.05m or lacks coverage, D is conditional reference, never perfect-oracle proof
resources: reuse all ROS runtime dependencies; cache<=900MiB, compact evidence<=150MiB; retain>=3GiB free; preserve all failed/startup/negative cohorts
stop: no automatic deployment, push, merge, next study or MPC migration
